rich_discovery.input: Create a PAGES analysis to help me understand my current perspective. I am Maya, manager of a four-person customer support team. Our ticketing system has a review queue. I reread and approve every escalated reply; agents wait for my approval before sending those replies. Last Tuesday I was away for half a day and eleven escalated replies waited. My goals are to protect response quality and reduce approval delays. I keep thinking, "I am the only person who can reliably protect our standards." We have not tested whether trained agents could meet the same standard. I want to see what makes my view so hard to change, not be told to delegate immediately.

transcript.content: Create a PAGES analysis of my recurring proposal impasse. I keep rewriting it and feel stuck.
What happened most recently that left you feeling stuck with the proposal?
Yesterday my sponsor said the proposal was unclear, so I rewrote the same introduction again. I have not asked what decision the sponsor needs to make.
What would you like this proposal to make possible?
I want the sponsor to decide whether to fund a two-week discovery phase. Make a first draft from this; leave anything unsupported empty.
